test_title: PYST 16: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 27 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The storm destroyed the entire village.

options.text: The entire village was destroyed by the storm.
The storm was destroying the entire village.
The village was being destroyed entirely by the storm.
The village was entirely destroyed by the storm.

solution:
The correct answer is **“The entire village was destroyed by the storm.”**
